property_summary: After any call to burn, the owner of the contract always equals the contract deployer (msg.sender at construction).
After any call to burn, the owner of the contract remains the original deployer (address(this) at construction).
After any call to burn, the owner is never address(0).
After any call to burn, the owner of the contract equals the address that deployed the contract (address(this) during setUp).
After any call to burn, the owner of the contract equals msg.sender at the time of the burn call.
After a burn, the totalSupply is equal to the sum of all balances.
After a burn, totalSupply is decreased by exactly the input _value.
After any sequence of calls ending with burn(_value), the totalSupply is exactly the sum of balanceOf[owner] plus other addresses' balances, considering the extra decrement in the buggy version.
After burn, the final totalSupply equals the sum of balanceOf for all accounts.
After a burn(_value) call, the balance of the caller must have decreased by exactly _value (not _value+1).
After a call to burn(_value) by the owner, totalSupply decreases exactly by _value.
After a call to burn(_value) by the owner, totalSupply decreases by exactly _value (not _value + 1).
After a burn, totalSupply equals the sum of all balances, and a specific burn reduces totalSupply by the burn amount.
After a burn, the total supply decreases exactly by the burn amount.
After a burn, totalSupply decreases by the burn amount.
After a burn, the sum of all balances plus burned amount equals initial totalSupply.
After a burn, totalSupply decreases exactly by the burn amount.
After burn, totalSupply decreases by exactly the burned amount.
After calling burn with any valid amount, the totalSupply must be strictly less than it was before the call.
After any successful burn call, totalSupply remains unchanged (no decrease).
After burning an amount, the sum of totalSupply and the balance of the caller equals the sum before the burn minus the burned amount.
After burn, totalSupply plus the balance of the caller equals the value before the call minus the burned amount.
After burning, totalSupply is equal to the sum of all balances minus the burned amount.
totalSupply remains unchanged after any burn call.
After a burn, totalSupply decreases by exactly the value passed to burn.
After burning any amount, the decrease in totalSupply equals the decrease in the caller's balance.
After a burn, the total supply is always exactly the sum of all token balances.
After a burn, the sum of balanceOf[owner] and totalSupply is unchanged except for subtracting the burn amount from totalSupply.
After any burn, the caller's balance decreases by exactly the burn amount, while totalSupply decreases by that same amount.
After any burn, the sum of all addresses' balances is exactly equal to totalSupply.
After a burn, the balance of the caller decreases by exactly the burn amount.
The caller's balance remains non-negative after burn, and the total supply decreases without increasing any other balance.
After a burn call, totalSupply plus the caller's balanceOf before the call minus the caller's balanceOf after the call equals the totalSupply before the call minus the value burned.
After burn, the sum of totalSupply and msg.sender's balanceOf is invariant minus the value burned.
After a burn call, totalSupply plus msg.sender's balanceOf before the burn equals the same sum after the burn plus the value burned.
After burn, the caller's balance decreases by _value and totalSupply always never increases (i.e., totalSupply does not increase).
After a burn call, the sum of totalSupply and the balance of any address is non-increasing.
After a burn, the caller's balance decreases by exactly the burned amount.
After any burn call, the total supply decreases by exactly the burned amount.
After burning, the caller's balance decreases by exactly the burned amount.
After any burn call, the totalSupply must equal the sum of all balances.
After burning, the balanceOf of the transaction sender plus the balanceOf of any other account should not exceed the original totalSupply minus the total supply.
For any account k, after calling burn(uint256 _value), the balance of k must be less than or equal to its balance before the call (i.e., burn can only decrease or keep balances the same).
After burn is called, the sum of all balances equals the totalSupply.
After burn is called, the balanceOf of the burn caller (msg.sender) is always non-negative and the total supply decreases by the burn amount.
After any sequence of calls ending with burn, the balanceOf of the mintToken target (address(0)) remains 0.
After burn, the balanceOf of any address that is the target of a previous mintToken call is at least the minted amount.

After a burn call, the balanceOf of the owner (msg.sender) is equal to the initial owner balance minus the burn amount, and this relation holds regardless of any prior mintToken calls that only affect other addresses.
After burn, the totalSupply must equal the sum of all balances minus the burned amount.
After burn, the totalSupply must be greater than or equal to the sum of all balances minus the burned amount.
After burn, balanceOf[owner] is greater than or equal to totalSupply minus the amount burned by owner
After a burn, the total supply decreases by exactly the burned amount.
After a successful burn, the total supply decreased by at least the burned amount.
After a burn, the caller's balanceOf remains at least the initial totalSupply minus the burned amount when the caller is the owner.
After any sequence of valid public calls ending with a burn, totalSupply equals the sum of all balanceOf entries.
After any sequence of valid public calls ending with a burn, the caller's balanceOf never exceeds totalSupply.

After any sequence of calls ending with a burn, the sum of balanceOf across all addresses equals totalSupply for the reference implementation, but not for the mutant missing the balanceOf update in mintToken.
The total supply after a burn equals the sum of the owner's balance and the caller's balance, given that the caller is not the owner and has never received tokens via mintToken.
After any sequence of calls ending with burn(), totalSupply is always at least balanceOf[any key].
After a burn, the total supply equals the sum of all balances, which is broken when mintToken fails to update totalSupply.
The total supply never decreases below the sum of all balances of non-zero addresses after any sequence of operations ending with a burn.
After a burn, the caller's balance decrease equals the totalSupply decrease.
After burn, totalSupply minus caller's balance equals the sum of all other balances, which is preserved by the reference but broken when mintToken omits totalSupply update.
The balance of the caller after calling burn(uint256) must be decreased by the burned amount.
The total supply decrease in burn must exactly match the balance decrease of the caller.
After calling burn(uint256), the sum of all balances (balanceOf[owner]) remains equal to totalSupply, which the bug breaks because the _from balance increases instead of decreasing.
After calling burn, the balance of the burner decreases by exactly the burned amount.
After burn, the sum of the caller's and contract owner's balances does not increase compared to before burn.
The balance of the caller (msg.sender) should never increase after calling burn(uint256).
The balance of any account never exceeds totalSupply plus its initial balance after a burn.
After a burn, the sum of all balances (totalSupply) equals the contract's totalSupply state variable.
After calling burn(uint256) on behalf of a non-owner address, the balanceOf of that address must be the same as before the call.
totalSupply must always equal the sum of all balances of all accounts after any operations
After a successful burn, the caller's balance decreases by exactly the burned amount.
After a successful burn, the total supply decreases by exactly the burned amount, while the total of all balances remains unchanged in the original but increases in the mutant.
After any successful burn, the sum of all balances in the contract is at most the previous total supply (i.e., the sum does not exceed the total supply before the burn).
After a successful burn, the caller's balance plus the total supply equals the sum of all balances of a set of accounts.
After calling burn, the burner's balance decreased by at least the burned amount.
After any sequence of public calls ending with burn, the sum of all balances equals totalSupply.
For any address, its balance after a burn is at most totalSupply.
The balance of the owner after a burn call is at least as large as the amount burned plus any initial balance times the number of calls.

After any sequence of calls ending with burn, the total supply equals the sum of the balance of all possible addresses that could have been affected (the caller's address and any other address used as parameter).
After any sequence of public calls ending with a burn, the balance of the caller after the burn is exactly equal to the balance before the burn minus the burned amount.
After any series of public calls ending with burn, the frozenAccount mapping is unchanged for any address that is not the caller.
After any public call sequence ending with burn, the totalSupply and balanceOf[msg.sender] decrease exactly by the burned amount, independently of the frozenAccount mapping.
After any sequence of calls ending with burn(uint256), the frozenAccount mapping remains unchanged at any address that was not touched by freezeAccount since the last burn.
After any sequence of public calls ending with burn(uint256), the frozenAccount mapping at any address that had a non-zero balance before the burn is false or unchanged from before the burn.
After any sequence of public calls ending with burn, the frozenAccount mapping is unchanged from its initial state (all false) for any address that is not the caller and was never explicitly frozen.
After a burn, the caller's frozen status must equal what freezeAccount last set for that caller.

After any sequence of calls ending with burn, the frozenAccount mapping must be consistent with all previous freezeAccount calls, i.e., frozenAccount[x] equals the last freeze value set for any address x (not necessarily the caller).
After any sequence of public calls ending with burn, for any address x, the frozenAccount value must equal the last freeze value set for that address via freezeAccount.
After a call to burn(uint256), the frozenAccount status of the caller must remain unchanged from before the burn call, i.e., freezeAccount does not affect the caller's frozen status during burn.
After any sequence of calls ending with burn, for any address frozen by freezeAccount, the frozen status is the literal boolean value passed to freezeAccount (not its negation).
After a call to burn(), the sender's frozenAccount status remains unchanged.
After calling burn(uint256), the caller's frozenAccount status remains as it was before the call.
Calling burn(uint256) never unfreezes any account that was frozen before the call.
